Fit a topic model to hexagon data (punkst topic-model)

Source: R/stages.R
punkst_topic_model.Rd

Exposes the options of punkst topic-model that apply to hexagon input (the 10X input options and --dataset-id are not applicable). Defaults are punkst's own, taken from its source (script/fit_lda.cpp) and docs, and an option is passed on the command line only when it differs from its default, so punkst's behaviour is unchanged unless you ask for it. Options whose default is "unset" (for example alpha, which punkst sets to 1/K) are NULL.

Usage

punkst_topic_model(
  hex,
  n_topics = NULL,
  n_epochs = 1L,
  out_prefix = NULL,
  seed = -1L,
  threads = 0L,
  minibatch_size = 512L,
  min_count_train = 20L,
  min_count_per_feature = 1L,
  include_feature_regex = NULL,
  exclude_feature_regex = NULL,
  icol_weight = -1L,
  default_weight = -1,
  modal = 0L,
  kappa = 0.7,
  tau0 = 10,
  alpha = NULL,
  eta = NULL,
  max_iter = 100L,
  mean_change_tol = 0.001,
  reproducible_init = FALSE,
  model_prior = NULL,
  prior_scale = NULL,
  prior_scale_rel = NULL,
  projection_only = FALSE,
  fit_background = FALSE,
  background_prior = NULL,
  background_init_scale = 0.5,
  background_prevalence_power = 0,
  fix_background = FALSE,
  bg_fraction_prior_a0 = 2,
  bg_fraction_prior_b0 = 8,
  warm_start_epochs = 0.5,
  adaptive_topics = FALSE,
  min_topic_mean = 1e-05,
  adaptive_refit_epochs = 1L,
  transform = TRUE,
  sort_topics = FALSE,
  topk_only = NULL,
  residuals = FALSE,
  feature_residuals = FALSE,
  feature_diagnostics_cheap = FALSE,
  unit_diagnostics_similarity = FALSE,
  pseudobulk_all_features = FALSE,
  count_cache = "auto",
  count_cache_memory_budget = "1G",
  temp_dir = NULL,
  debug = 0L,
  verbose = 0L,
  bin = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

hex

A punkstHex object from punkst_tiles2hex(); it supplies --in-data, --in-meta and --features.

n_topics

Number of topics (--n-topics). Required unless model_prior is given.

n_epochs

Training passes over the data (--n-epochs).

out_prefix

Output prefix; default <workdir>/<hex stem>.k<n_topics>.

seed

Random seed (--seed). The default -1 lets punkst draw a random seed, so runs are not reproducible unless you set one.

threads

Threads (--threads); 0 lets punkst (TBB) choose.

minibatch_size

Minibatch size (--minibatch-size).

min_count_train

Minimum total count for a unit to be trained on (--min-count-train).

min_count_per_feature

Minimum total count for a feature to be kept (--min-count-per-feature).

include_feature_regex, exclude_feature_regex

Regular expressions selecting features (--include-feature-regex, --exclude-feature-regex); e.g. xenium_control_regex().

icol_weight

0-based column of per-feature weights in the feature file (--icol-weight); -1 disables weighting.

default_weight

Weight for model or prior features missing from the feature file (--default-weight); negative drops them.

modal

Modality index (--modal).

kappa, tau0

Online learning decay rate and offset (--kappa, --tau0).

alpha, eta

Document-topic and topic-word priors (--alpha, --eta); NULL uses 1/K.

max_iter, mean_change_tol

Per-document inference limits (--max-iter, --mean-change-tol).

reproducible_init

Deterministic per-document initialisation, slower (--reproducible-init).

model_prior

File with an initial model matrix for continued training (--model-prior).

prior_scale, prior_scale_rel

Scaling of the prior model (--prior-scale, --prior-scale-rel; the relative one wins).

projection_only

Transform with model_prior and do not train (--projection-only).

fit_background

Fit a background component in addition to the topics (--fit-background).

background_prior

File with a background prior vector (--background-prior).

background_init_scale, background_prevalence_power, fix_background, bg_fraction_prior_a0, bg_fraction_prior_b0, warm_start_epochs

Background model settings (--background-init-scale, --background-prevalence-power, --fix-background, --bg-fraction-prior-a0, --bg-fraction-prior-b0, --warm-start-epochs).

adaptive_topics

Treat n_topics as an upper bound, prune unused topics and refit (--adaptive-topics).

min_topic_mean, adaptive_refit_epochs

Adaptive fitting settings (--min-topic-mean, --adaptive-refit-epochs).

transform

Transform the data to topic space after fitting (--transform); needed for the results and pseudobulk files.

sort_topics

Sort topics by weight (--sort-topics).

topk_only

If set, write only the top-k topics per unit to the results file (--topk-only).

residuals, feature_residuals, feature_diagnostics_cheap, unit_diagnostics_similarity, pseudobulk_all_features

Diagnostic and output options (flags of the same names).

count_cache, count_cache_memory_budget

Repeated-pass count cache (--count-cache: "off", "on", "auto"; --count-cache-memory-budget with K, M or G suffixes).

temp_dir

Parent directory for temporary files (--temp-dir); NULL uses the system temporary directory.

debug

If > 0, process only this many units (--debug).

verbose

Verbosity (--verbose).

bin

Path to punkst; see punkst_setup().

overwrite

Re-run even if the manifest shows the stage is up to date.

Value

A punkstModel stage object. files holds model (features x topics) and state always, plus results (per-unit topic proportions) and pseudobulk when the transform ran, and unit_stats when residuals is on.

Details

One deliberate difference: punkst does not run the transform by default, but the results file is what most users need, so transform = TRUE here. Note also that punkst does not sort topics unless sort_topics = TRUE.

Examples

# Requires the 'punkst' binary (see check_punkst_setup()); skipped otherwise.
hex <- punkstHex(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(data = tempfile(), meta = tempfile()), params = list())
tryCatch(
    punkst_topic_model(hex, n_topics = 2L),
    error = function(e) message("punkst not available: ", conditionMessage(e)))
